# Safe code review: `62fc379...HEAD` (PR #3199)

**Mode:** explicit range, committed work only. 2 agents ran 5 of the 9 areas (security, bugs, regression, testing, performance). I ran architecture, DRY, simplicity (KISS), conventions and the finding checks myself, because the 2-agent limit left no agents for them.

**Scope:** 24 files, +1444 −77 · base `62fc379` → `e6bfd68` (5 commits)
**Repo:** safe-client-gateway · TypeScript/NestJS · vitest · 3 written rules in AGENTS.md (layering, updating specs when adding constructor dependencies, SPDX headers) · all 9 areas had code to check

| | |
|---|---|
| **Verdict** | OK to open the PR once you've settled the Zerion budget default (REG-001) |
| **Score** | **~91 / 100** · checked 7 of 7 scored findings |
| **Main drag** | A default of 2 calls per 10s now covers 3 more Zerion endpoints; limiter wiring in 2 datasources is untested |
| **Fix first** | REG-001, then TST-001 |

## Scores by area (worst first)
| Area | Score | Findings |
|---|---|---|
| Testing | 78 | 1 medium, 1 low, 1 minor |
| Regression | 85 | 1 medium |
| Bugs | 95 | 1 low |
| Performance | 95 | 1 low |
| DRY | 98 | 1 minor |
| Conventions | 98 | 1 minor |
| Security | 100 | 1 older issue, not scored |
| Architecture | 100 | 2 older issues, not scored |
| KISS | 100 | nothing found |

## Not covered
- The production value of `ZERION_RATE_LIMIT_CALLS_BY_PERIOD`. It isn't in the repo, and REG-001 depends on it.
- No tests were run and nothing was installed, as you asked.
- Each finding was checked by me in a single pass. The usual paired prove-and-attack agents didn't run because of the 2-agent limit.

## Fix before opening

**REG-001 · Regression · P2 · confidence 55**
`src/config/entities/configuration.ts:140` (with `src/modules/zerion/datasources/zerion-rate-limiter.service.ts:92-101`)
- **What happens:** before this change, only `ZerionBalancesApi` (balances and collectibles) used the `zerion` counter. Now `ZerionPortfolioApi` (`zerion-portfolio-api.service.ts:122`), `ZerionPositionsApi` (`zerion-positions-api.service.ts:109`) and `ZerionWalletPortfolioApi` (`zerion-wallet-portfolio-api.service.ts:99`) use it too. The default `limitCalls` stayed at **2 per 10s**, while the limiter's own doc comment says Zerion allows about 10 per second.
- **Effect:** in any environment using the default, `/v1/portfolio` and `/positions` start returning 429s under normal traffic, where they never did before. `/v2/safes` would fall back to the balances service most of the time.
- **Hint:** the test config at `src/config/entities/__tests__/configuration.ts:78` had to raise `limitCalls` to 1000+ just to keep app-boot tests working.
- **Fix:** raise the default to match the real Zerion ceiling, or make raising the env var an explicit rollout step in the PR description.

**TST-001 · Testing · P2 · confidence 70** (I checked both spec files)
`src/modules/positions/datasources/zerion-positions-api.service.ts:109` and `src/modules/portfolio/datasources/zerion-portfolio-api.service.ts:122`
- **What's missing:** both specs only stub `assertWithinBudget: vi.fn()` (positions spec :26, portfolio spec :57). Neither tells the stub to throw, checks that it was called, or imports `LimitReachedError`. Deleting either `assertWithinBudget` call would leave every test green.
- **Fix:** copy the two tests already in `zerion-balances-api.service.spec.ts`: one where the budget is exceeded and there's no network call, and one where the error comes through as `LimitReachedError` rather than wrapped.

## Worth a ticket / your call (P3 and below)
| ID | Where | Finding |
|---|---|---|
| BUG-001 | `src/modules/zerion/datasources/zerion-rate-limiter.service.ts:76` | The per-address limit only applies when `address` is passed, and only `wallet_portfolio` passes it (`zerion-wallet-portfolio-api.service.ts:99-102`). Balances (`zerion-balances-api.service.ts:136,198`), portfolio (`:122`, which has `args.address`) and positions don't. Turning on `ZERION_RATE_LIMIT_PER_ADDRESS_CALLS_BY_PERIOD` therefore doesn't stop one busy wallet on `/balances` from using up the shared budget. That contradicts the `.env.sample.json:1587` text and the class doc. Confidence 60. |
| PRF-001 | `src/modules/safe/routes/v2/safes.v2.service.ts:84-88` | `resolveZerionEligibility` and `resolveSafes` both depend only on `chainsById`, yet run one after the other. Each `/v2/safes` request pays an extra round trip (feature-flag `getChainV2` vs `getSafe`). Wrap them in a `Promise.all`. Confidence 45. |
| TST-002 | `src/modules/safe/routes/v2/safes.v2.service.ts:191-198, 160-162` | No test makes `getChain` fail, so the new "chain missing, drop this entry only" path is unguarded. Confidence 35. |
| TST-003 | `src/modules/safe/routes/v2/safes.v2.service.ts:299-328` | The log branches for `ZodError` and `LimitReachedError` are never hit: every test rejects with a plain `Error`. Minor. |
| DRY-001 | `src/datasources/cache/__tests__/fake.cache.service.ts:82-87` | `incrWithTtl` is a word-for-word copy of `increment` (`:72-80`). It could just call `this.increment(cacheKey, ttl)`. Minor. |
| CNV-001 | `src/modules/zerion/datasources/zerion-rate-limiter.service.ts:116-118` | The fail-open warning is a plain string, while `_logRateLimited` in the same new file uses the structured `{ type: LogType… }` form. That makes the fail-open event hard to query. Minor. |

## Worth tidying (older issues, no effect on the score)
1. **ARC-001:** `src/routes/common/guards/rate-limit.guard.ts:35` and `src/modules/hooks/domain/helpers/event-cache.helper.ts:174` still use `increment`. This PR's own docs at `src/datasources/cache/redis.cache.service.ts:133-139` say its `EXPIRE … NX` is broken on Redis 6, so the request rate-limit guard has the same window-never-resets problem. Suggest a ticket to move it to `incrWithTtl`.
2. **ARC-002:** `src/modules/safe/routes/v2/safes.v2.service.ts:11,34` injects the `IZerionWalletPortfolioApi` datasource straight into a service. AGENTS.md says services call repositories, never datasources. This predates the PR, but the change leans on it more. Ticket.
3. DRY-001 above: a 1-line cleanup you can do now.

About 10 lines to tidy now plus 2 tickets. I didn't propose any fixes to code the PR only touched in passing.

## Not sure about these
- **SEC-001** (downgraded to an older issue): `/v2/safes` has no `RateLimitGuard`, so an anonymous caller can use up the shared Zerion counter. But before this PR, `/balances` and `/collectibles` could already exhaust the same counter without a login, and `/v2/safes` hit Zerion itself with no limit at all. So the change doesn't add exposure, it moves where the exhaustion happens. Worth adding `RateLimitGuard` to `src/modules/safe/routes/v2/safes.v2.controller.ts:73` at some point.

## Ruled out
- **Fallback amplification:** when the portfolio is over budget, the fallback goes through `BalancesApiManager.getApi`. For Safes that `getSafe` confirmed are deployed, that returns the Safe balances API, not Zerion (`balances-api.manager.ts:66-69`). No extra Zerion calls.
- **Bugs pass:** found nothing. The Lua `INCR`+`EXPIRE` is atomic. The `> limit` boundary matches the old behaviour. `LimitReachedError` is passed through at every call site (balances :229, positions :146; portfolio and wallet-portfolio call the limiter outside their `try` blocks).
- **Every changed file has the SPDX header** (`.json` doesn't take one).

## How this was produced
- **Scope:** `git diff 62fc379...HEAD` only, read-only.
- **Agents:** 2 `code-reviewer` agents (security+bugs+regression, and testing+performance). Everything else, including checking findings and scoring, I did myself.
- **Not written:** no fix/ticket/skip follow-up was run, no `last-run` file was written, and nothing was posted.
